totalSubsYTD.description: The total amount in the account during the tax year to date that qualifies for a bonus payment. You can include an amount up to 2 decimal places. The totalSubsYTD must be the same as or more than totalSubsForPeriod.

bonusPaidYTD.description: The total bonus payment that has already been claimed and paid in the tax year to date. You can include an amount up to 2 decimal places.
